Need understand criterion: "A user story contains nothing more than role, means, and optional ends/rationale. Violation when the core story includes comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other information that should be external to the story sentence."

We need classify each story. Most are in format "As a [role], I want to [means], so that [ends]" or just "As a [role], I want to [means]." These are minimal. Need identify any that include extra info comments, notes, implementation details, UI details, testing hints, procedural notes, or other external info. The project Zooniverse stories mostly seem concise. Need inspect each. Likely all no violation except maybe some with extra clauses? Need ensure minimal means only role, means, optional ends. Let's list all.

ZO-001: As a user, I want to search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting.
Role user, means search/discover music using content identification or fingerprinting. Does "using content identification or fingerprinting" count implementation? It is part of means? Could be technical implementation but as requirement maybe acceptable? Minimal criterion only additional info beyond role means ends. This is within means. No extra notes. No violation.

ZO-002: As a user, I want to search and discover music based on my profile. Means. No violation.

ZO-003: As a user, I want to search and discover music based on other users similar to myself. Means. No violation.

Means includes "have tags available for all further processing steps" maybe is an outcome/procedural? It is still means/desire. Minimal?
